description: This Java source file defines the 'Component' entity class for the Fineract project, representing a component within a survey in the database. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, extending an abstract persistable class, and contains fields such as survey reference, key, text, description, and sequence number with appropriate getters and setters.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents a survey component entity that is mapped to the 'm_survey_components' table, including relationships and attributes related to survey components.
